objective: Produce a deterministic JSON test plan with disjoint positive and negative controls
prompt: Return only JSON. Use schema giga.test-plan.v1 with exactly schema and tests at top level. Include a non-empty tests array. Every test needs non-empty string fields id, kind, input and expected. Include at least one kind=positive and one kind=negative_control. Test IDs and inputs must be unique. A negative_control expected value must explicitly reject, fail or error. Expected values must be deterministic: no should, baseline, uncertainty, indicate or alternative 'or' outcomes.
